items.title: MUSS: A Multi-scale and Sequence-based Model for Single-cell Gene Regulation
items.title_zh: MUSS：一个用于单细胞基因调控的多尺度且基于序列的模型
items.summary_zh: 在单细胞中建模基因调控需要跨调控尺度联合表示DNA序列、染色质可及性和基因表达。基于序列的模型捕获DNA水平的调控语法，但通常缺乏细胞水平的分辨率，而许多单细胞组学模型将基因和峰表示为固定词汇的标记，而没有其底层序列。在这里，我们提出了MUSS，一个基于序列的单细胞基因调控多尺度模型，同时保留DNA水平和细胞水平的分辨率。MUSS使用冻结的预训练序列编码器从DNA推导峰和基因水平的表示，并通过峰-峰自注意力和距离偏置的峰-基因相互作用进行整合。峰掩码语言建模随后在配对的scATAC-seq和scRNA-seq上训练，将这些表示与细胞特异性调控状态对齐。在基因表达预测、增强子-基因连接、基序引导的调控优先级排序和零样本细胞聚类方面，MUSS相对于基于序列和单细胞组学的基线取得了强劲性能。它进一步预测任务训练期间未见过的基因和峰的表达。这些结果支持基于序列的多尺度表示用于解码细胞类型特异性调控

extra.description: Modeling gene regulation in single cells requires jointly representing DNA sequence, chromatin accessibility, and gene expression across regulatory scales. Sequence-based models capture DNA-level regulatory grammar but often lack cell-level resolution, whereas many single-cell omics models represent genes and peaks as fixed-vocabulary tokens without their underlying sequence. Here, we present MUSS, a sequence-based multi-scale model for single-cell gene regulation that preserves both DNA-level and cell-level resolution. MUSS derives peak- and gene-level representations from DNA using a frozen pre-trained sequence encoder and integrates them through peak-peak self-attention and distance-biased peak-gene interactions. Peak masked language modeling followed by training on paired scATAC-seq and scRNA-seq aligns these representations with cell-specific regulatory states. Across gene expression prediction, enhancer-gene linking, motif-guided regulatory prioritization, and zero-shot cell clustering, MUSS achieves strong performance against sequence-based and single-cell omics baselines. It further predicts expression for genes and peaks unseen during task training. These results support sequence-grounded, multi-scale representations for decoding cell-type-specific regulatory programs. Code, datasets, and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/Lotfollahi-lab/MUSS_neurips26.

items.title: Attribution-based diagnostics for single-cell foundation models
items.title_zh: 基于归因的单细胞基础模型诊断
items.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA基础模型（scFM）越来越多地用于计算机生物发现，但仅凭预测性能无法揭示其决策依赖的是具有生物学意义的信号还是模型特定的捷径。我们系统研究了两个任务中下游预测的事后归因：使用预训练Cell2Sentence和scGPT模型进行细胞类型注释，以及在受控设置中使用scGPT+STATE进行扰动预测。对于细胞注释，我们使用归因评估预测是否依赖已确立的标记基因，以及它们的相关性如何随模型架构、表达排名和周围细胞上下文变化。对于扰动预测，我们在合成设置中将归因模式与已知调控真值比较，以评估它们对模型学习计算的揭示。在这些任务中，归因揭示了生物特征使用、上下文交互、不同输入通路的贡献、学习进展、与预测质量的关联，以及标准性能指标未完全捕捉的潜在陷阱。使用完整和有限调控知识的实验进一步表明，从归因得出的结论强烈依赖于生物参考、基线和零模型的选择。总之，这些发现凸显了归因作为灵活事后诊断的价值

extra.description: Single-cell RNA foundation models (scFMs) are increasingly used for in-silico biological discovery, yet predictive performance alone does not reveal whether their decisions rely on biologically meaningful signals or model-specific shortcuts. We systematically investigate post-hoc attribution of downstream predictions across two tasks: cell-type annotation using pretrained Cell2Sentence and scGPT models, and perturbation prediction using scGPT+STATE in a controlled setting. For cell annotation, we use attribution to assess whether predictions rely on established marker genes and how their relevance varies with model architecture, expression rank, and the surrounding cellular context. For perturbation prediction, we compare attribution patterns with known regulatory ground-truth in a synthetic setting to assess what they reveal about the model's learned computations. Across these tasks, attribution reveals biological feature use, contextual interactions, contributions from different input pathways, learning progression, associations with prediction quality, and potential pitfalls that are not fully captured by standard performance metrics. Experiments with complete and limited regulatory knowledge further demonstrate that conclusions drawn from attribution depend strongly on the choice of biological reference, baseline, and null model. Together, these findings highlight the value of attribution as a flexible post-hoc diagnostic for understanding model behavior, identifying potential issues, and informing the development of scFMs.

items.title: Rethinking One Gene, One Token: Transcriptome-Aware Tokenization for Single-Cell Foundation Models
items.title_zh: 重新思考一基因一标记：面向单细胞基础模型的转录组感知标记化
items.summary_zh: 单细胞基础模型通常将每个基因视为一个标记，这既昂贵又浪费。一个细胞可以表达数千个基因，因此每个基因一个标记使自注意力计算代价高昂，然而其中许多基因以低水平检测到，携带的信号太少，不值得拥有自己的标记。一起表达的基因可以共享一个标记，而为突出的基因保留单独的标记。我们介绍scTAT（转录组感知标记化），它将基因集词汇表与逐细胞分词器配对。该词汇表包含在预训练语料中具有稳定相对表达的重叠基因集。使用这些集合带来两个困难。第一，哪些基因应共享一个标记取决于细胞，而现有多基因标记预先固定分组。第二，不同大小的基因集必须与单基因在共同尺度上比较。因此分词器逐细胞决定，让基因集和单基因在按集合大小平方根归一化的表达分数下竞争标记位置。训练仍然重建单个基因，因此预测保持在基因分辨率。在冻结嵌入细胞类型注释中，scTAT以一半的标记预算匹配最强的一基因一标记模型。在相同预算下，其相对于一基因一标记模型的优

extra.description: Single-cell foundation models typically treat each gene as a token, which is both costly and wasteful. A cell can express thousands of genes, so one token per gene makes self-attention expensive, yet many of these genes are detected at low levels and carry too little signal to deserve a token of their own. Genes that are expressed together could instead share a token, leaving separate tokens for genes that stand out. We introduce scTAT (Transcriptome-Aware Tokenization), which pairs a gene-set vocabulary with a per-cell tokenizer. The vocabulary holds overlapping gene sets that recur with stable relative expression across the pretraining corpus. Using these sets raises two difficulties. First, which genes should share a token depends on the cell, whereas existing multi-gene tokens fix the grouping in advance. Second, gene sets of different sizes must be compared with single genes on a common scale. The tokenizer therefore decides per cell, letting gene sets and single genes compete for token positions under an expression score normalized by the square root of set size. Training still reconstructs individual genes, so predictions stay at gene resolution. In frozen-embedding cell-type annotation, scTAT matches the strongest one-gene-per-token model with half the token budget. Its advantage over one-gene-per-token models at the same budget grows as the budget shrinks and the tokenizer assigns more positions to gene sets. Encoding the same genes with gene-set tokens also nearly halves the Transformer's matrix-multiplication cost. These results show that a token need not hold exactly one gene: when the tokenizer decides per cell which genes share a token, a fixed budget covers more of each transcriptome at no cost in annotation accuracy.

items.title: Hybrid Machine Learning for Imbalanced Landing-Phase Safety Event Prediction from Flight Data
items.title_zh: 用于飞行数据中不平衡着陆阶段安全事件预测的混合机器学习
items.summary_zh: 着陆阶段安全事件预测需要在强烈不平衡的多变量飞行数据中检测罕见的异常进近。在区分不同机场运行背景下的事件特定特征的同时捕获耦合的时间行为仍然是一个核心建模挑战。本研究提出了一个可解释的混合特征融合框架，用于多类着陆阶段安全事件预测。在正常飞行窗口上训练的长短期记忆（LSTM）自编码器表征偏离常规进近行为的情况。其连续重建误差描述符与参数特定的统计飞行历史特征融合，并提供给类别加权XGBoost分类器，以区分正常、速度高、路径高和襟翼晚窗口。该框架使用来自三个到达机场的53750个NASA DASHlink进近窗口进行评估。比较了汇总和机场特定学习策略以及组件级基准、重复流水线再训练和特征归因分析。结果表明在重复划分和再训练下所有机场的平均宏召回率高于0.90，具有强类别平衡检测能力。组件比较确立了类别加权的重要性，并表明连续特征融合优于仅重建误差和硬门控替代方案。机场级比较揭示了在数据集较

extra.description: Landing-phase safety-event prediction requires the detection of rare abnormal approaches within strongly imbalanced multivariate flight data. Capturing coupled temporal behavior while distinguishing event-specific signatures across airport operating contexts remains a central modeling challenge. This study proposes an interpretable hybrid feature-fusion framework for multiclass landing-phase safety-event prediction. A long short-term memory (LSTM) autoencoder trained on nominal flight windows characterizes deviations from routine approach behavior. Its continuous reconstruction-error descriptor is fused with parameter-specific statistical flight-history features and supplied to a class-weighted XGBoost classifier to distinguish Normal, Speed High, Path High, and Flaps Late windows. The framework is evaluated using 53,750 NASA DASHlink approach windows from three arrival airports. Pooled and airport-specific learning strategies are compared alongside component-level benchmarks, repeated pipeline retraining, and feature-attribution analysis. The results demonstrate strong class-balanced detection, with mean macro recall above 0.90 across all airports under repeated partitioning and retraining. Component comparisons establish the importance of class weighting and show that continuous feature fusion outperforms reconstruction-error-only and hard-gate alternatives. Airport-level comparisons reveal benefits from local specialization at the two airports with larger datasets and from pooled training at the airport with the smallest dataset. Feature attributions associate predictions with operationally relevant vertical-path, configuration, speed, and approach-context variables. The framework provides an interpretable approach to rare-event detection and practical guidance for adapting flight-data monitoring models to airport-level data availability.

items.title: HELICS: Biobank-scale Conditional Synthetic Genome Generation via Latent Flow Matching
items.title_zh: HELICS：通过潜在流匹配进行生物样本库规模的条件合成基因组生成
items.summary_zh: 个体水平基因型数据支撑遗传发现、疾病风险建模和治疗开发，然而许多关键场景仍数据有限，包括代表性不足的祖先群体、罕见或不平衡疾病队列以及受限访问的生物样本库。条件合成基因组生成将支持隐私感知的基准测试、模拟和数据增强，但需要学习数十万至数千万相关单核苷酸多态性（SNPs，即DNA变异位点）上的超高维离散分布。我们引入HELICS：通过潜在插值条件合成的高保真生成，一个无定相潜在流匹配框架，用于从生物样本库规模基因型数据进行全基因组SNP水平生成。HELICS用卷积自编码器对染色体进行标记化，将>600K SNPs缩减为4,096个连续潜在标记，并在拼接的多染色体潜在表示上训练参数化条件流匹配的transformer模型。在英国生物样本库超过417K基因组上训练，HELICS无需单倍型定相即可生成全基因组常见变异合成队列，并比现有基于单倍型的模拟器更忠实于真实基因型，包括外部评估中高等位基因频

extra.description: Individual-level genotype data underpin genetic discovery, disease-risk modeling, and therapeutic development, yet many critical settings remain data-limited, including underrepresented ancestries, rare or imbalanced disease cohorts, and restricted-access biobanks. Conditional synthetic genome generation would support privacy-aware benchmarking, simulation, and data augmentation, but requires learning an ultra-high-dimensional discrete distribution over hundreds of thousands to tens of millions of correlated single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs), or sites of DNA variation. We introduce HELICS: High-fidelity gEneration via Latent Interpolant Conditional Synthesis, a phasing-free latent flow matching framework for genome-wide SNP-level generation from biobank-scale genotype data. HELICS tokenizes chromosomes with convolutional autoencoders, reducing >600K SNPs to 4,096 continuous latent tokens, and trains a transformer parameterized conditional flow matching model over the concatenated multi-chromosome latent representation. Trained on over 417K genomes in the UK Biobank, HELICS generates genome-wide common-variant synthetic cohorts without haplotype phasing and achieves stronger fidelity to real genotypes than existing haplotype-based simulators, including high allele-frequency agreement in external evaluation and superior preservation of local and long-range SNP correlation structure. Conditioning on ancestry and genetic liability summaries enables targeted generation across genetic risk profiles; in perturbation analyses, by increasing the conditioned disease trait liability, HELICS induces SNP-level dosage changes in generated genomes that are highly correlated with published association weights. HELICS provides a scalable generative modeling framework for SNP-level genome data and a path toward conditional synthetic cohorts for data-limited genetic studies.

items.title: SHORE: Stability-Hybrid On-Policy Reinforcement Learning for Online Bin Packing
items.title_zh: SHORE：用于在线装箱的稳定性混合同策略强化学习
items.summary_zh: 带处理缓冲区的在线3D装箱需要在未知未来到达的情况下选择装箱哪个箱子、其方向和放置位置，同时保持堆叠稳定。坍塌会结束回合并丧失剩余体积。现有方法使用几何规则或硬稳定性掩码，限制了风险对箱子、方向和放置联合选择的影响方式。我们提出了稳定性混合同策略强化学习（SHORE），它将放置的学习稳定性概率与其在稳定条件下的同策略回报估计相结合。3D U-Net从执行结果和模拟替代方案中学习稳定性，揭示早期回合中代表性不足的动作结果。离散同策略演员-评论家在其动作值和策略先验中使用稳定性预测，并设有门控以限制未训练或变化模型的影响。在部署中，SHORE不需要额外的搜索或模拟开销。在Isaac Gym中，SHORE在40万环境步时达到73%的空间利用率，而没有稳定性建模的同一学习器在约100万步时达到该水平。在扩展的60箱集合上，SHORE实现0.734的空间利用率，而GOPT最先进基线为0.588，放置

extra.description: Online 3D bin packing with a processing buffer requires choosing which box to pack, its orientation, and its placement while keeping the stack stable under unknown future arrivals. A collapse ends the episode and forfeits the remaining volume. Existing methods use geometric rules or hard stability masks, limiting how risk can influence the joint choice of box, orientation, and placement. We propose Stability-Hybrid On-Policy Reinforcement Learning (SHORE), which combines a learned stability probability of a placement with an on-policy estimate of its return conditional on stability. A 3D U-Net learns stability from executed outcomes and simulated alternatives, revealing outcomes of actions underrepresented in early rollouts. A discrete on-policy actor--critic uses stability predictions in both its action values and policy prior, with gates that limit the effect of an untrained or changing model. In deployment, SHORE does not require additional search or simulation overhead. In Isaac Gym, SHORE reaches 73\% space utilization by 0.4M environment steps, while the same learner without stability modeling reaches that level at about 1M. On the expanded 60-box set, SHORE achieves 0.734 space utilization versus 0.588 for the GOPT state-of-the-art baseline, with a higher placement-failure frequency (1.03\% vs. 0.63\%), trading more risk for greater packed volume. The results show faster learning and higher utilization on the more demanding realistic box arrival set. Ablations suggest that simulated alternatives provide useful early supervision, while executed outcomes alone sustain later performance. We also demonstrate the method on a real robot to verify the simplicity of integrating the method to real bin packing pipelines.

items.title: Comparative Strategies for Handling Imbalanced QSAR Regression: A Case Study on hERG Activity Prediction
items.title_zh: 处理不平衡QSAR回归的比较策略：hERG活性预测案例研究
items.summary_zh: 数据不平衡在QSAR建模中经常出现，但大多数研究集中于分类任务，很少涉及回归任务，因为确定数据的稀疏或密集区域具有挑战性。数据级和算法级的不平衡处理策略可能对模型性能产生不同影响。在本研究中，我们系统比较了GCN和基于指纹的机器学习模型中的各种策略。为更有意义地评估模型性能，我们基于领域知识和数据分布将目标区域划分为若干子区域。我们重点关注最具实际意义的区域。结果表明，基于该关注区域指标选择模型比使用总区域指标能带来更可靠的性能。我们还观察到，不同不平衡处理策略的效果因模型类型而异。这些发现凸显了回归QSAR建模中区域感知评估的重要性，并为不平衡数据集选择适当策略提供了实用指导。

extra.description: Data imbalance frequently occurs in QSAR modeling, yet most studies focus on classification tasks, and few address regression tasks, as it is challenging to determine which regions of the data are sparse or dense. Data-level and algorithm-level imbalance-handling strategies can have different effects on model performance. In this study, we systematically compare various strategies across GCN and fingerprint-based machine learning models. To evaluate model performance more meaningfully, we partitioned the target region into several subregions based on both domain knowledge and data distribution. We focused on the region of greatest practical interest. Our results demonstrate that selecting models based on this interest-region metric leads to more reliable performance than using the total region metric. We also observed that different imbalance-handling strategies can have divergent effects depending on the model type. These findings highlight the importance of region-aware evaluation in regression QSAR modeling and provide practical guidance for selecting appropriate strategies for imbalanced datasets.

items.title: Synthesis of Ovarian Cancer Multi-Omics Datasets: A Biology-Informed Evaluation Framework
items.title_zh: 卵巢癌多组学数据集的合成：一个生物学信息评估框架
items.summary_zh: 配对的多组学癌症队列组装成本高昂且难以共享，促使合成队列成为补充资源。随着生成模型开发的加速，我们将重点从提出又一个架构转向定义评估标准，以确定合成数据是否保留生物学相关结构。我们引入了一个生物学信息且患者不相交的框架，用于评估配对RNA表达和拷贝数变异（CNV）谱的生成，并将其应用于纵向DECIDER高级别浆液性卵巢癌队列。该框架以真实训练和留出数据之间的一致性为参考，评估模态特异性保真度和RNA与CNV对之间的一致性，以及补充的训练数据邻近性诊断。我们改编了三种基于变分自编码器的多组学整合架构来生成配对谱。在多项保真度和一致性指标上领先的模型也显示出最强的训练数据邻近性。该协议和案例研究为社区提供了比较未来多组学生成器的参考。

extra.description: Paired multi-omic cancer cohorts are costly to assemble and difficult to share, motivating synthetic cohorts as a complementary resource. As generative model development accelerates, we shift the focus from proposing yet another architecture to defining evaluation criteria that determine whether synthetic data preserve biologically relevant structure. We introduce a biology-informed and patient-disjoint framework for evaluating the generation of paired RNA expression and copy-number variation (CNV) profiles, and apply it to the longitudinal DECIDER high-grade serous ovarian cancer cohort. The framework assesses modality-specific fidelity and coherence between RNA and CNV pairs using agreement between real training and held-out data as a reference, alongside complementary training-data proximity diagnostics. We adapt three multi-omic integration architectures based on variational autoencoders to generate paired profiles. The model leading several fidelity and coherence measures also shows the strongest training-data proximity. The protocol and case study offer the community a reference for comparing future multi-omic generators.

items.title: HistoTx: Early fusion of H&E images and spatial transcriptomics at varying spatial transcriptomics resolution with self-supervised learning
items.title_zh: HistoTx：在不同空间转录组学分辨率下，通过自监督学习对H&E图像和空间转录组学进行早期融合
items.summary_zh: 空间转录组学绘制组织切片上的基因表达图谱，当与全切片图像整合时，可联合捕获形态结构和分子活动，从而提供组织生物学的丰富多模态视图。将空间转录组学与WSI结合的ML方法通常通过对比对齐或对病理基础模型进行监督微调，学习从形态特征到分子谱的映射。在这两种情况下，转录组学都作为训练信号而非真正的输入模态，使推理从根本上由图像驱动。我们提出一种早期融合视觉Transformer架构，其中转录组token以任意空间分辨率构建，与图像块token合并，并通过共享Transformer堆栈联合处理，以实现深度跨模态交互。从预训练的纯视觉病理基础模型出发，我们通过在配对的图像和空间转录组学数据上继续自监督预训练来训练HistoTx，并证明：1）在仅使用图像进行推理时，性能在大多数任务上与基线持平，同时在本质上受益于分子知识的任务（如基因表达预测）上有所提升；2）当推理时两种模态均可用时，联合提供图像和转录

extra.description: Spatial transcriptomics maps gene expression across tissue sections and, when integrated with whole slide images, jointly captures both morphological architecture and molecular activity to provide a rich, multimodal view of tissue biology. ML approaches combining spatial transcriptomics and WSIs typically learn a mapping from morphological features to molecular profiles via contrastive alignment or supervised fine-tuning of pathology foundation models. In both cases, transcriptomics serves as a training signal rather than a true input modality, leaving inference fundamentally image-driven. We propose an early-fusion vision transformer architecture in which transcript tokens are constructed at arbitrary spatial resolution, merged with image patch tokens, and jointly processed through a shared transformer stack for deep cross-modal interaction. Starting from a pretrained vision-only pathology foundation model, we train HistoTx by continuing self-supervised pretraining on paired image and spatial transcriptomics data and demonstrate that: 1) at inference with image only, performance remains on par with the baseline on most tasks while improving on tasks that inherently benefit from molecular knowledge, such as gene expression prediction; 2) when both modalities are available at inference, jointly providing image and transcript inputs outperforms either modality alone.

items.title: An autoencoder outperforms two transformers on prediction of gene expression from chromatin accessibility
items.title_zh: 自编码器在从染色质可及性预测基因表达上优于两个 transformer
items.summary_zh: 从染色质可及性预测 RNA 丰度的模型很少在相同特征、目标和指标下比较。我们在来自 19 项人类研究的 126,604 个配对单核图谱上构建了一个基准，共享 50,000 个峰和 3,185 个基因的词表、十个 5x2 交叉验证折和一个评分目标，并在 70 次训练运行中比较了七个已实现流程和两个参考预测器；每个流程保留自己的输入归一化和原生训练目标。基于双变分自编码器的 scButterfly-B 流程在所有六十个配对折比较中，在每基因和细胞内 Spearman 相关上优于所有 transformer 流程，包括自回归 Perceiver 模型（Omic Translator）和无支持重构的 Cisformer，训练时间短 3.8 倍。Transformer 流程在细胞内轮廓形状上差距为 0.02-0.04，但在每基因相关上落后 0.10-0.24。在两个留出细胞类型上每基因相关较低；对照

extra.description: Models that predict RNA abundance from chromatin accessibility are rarely compared under the same features, targets and metrics. We built one benchmark on 126,604 paired single-nucleus profiles from 19 human studies with a shared vocabulary of 50,000 peaks and 3,185 genes, ten 5x2 cross-validation folds and one scoring target, and compared seven implemented pipelines and two reference predictors across 70 trained runs; each pipeline keeps its own input normalisation and native training target. The scButterfly-B pipeline, built on dual variational autoencoders, outperformed every transformer pipeline, including an autoregressive Perceiver model (Omic Translator) and a support-free reformulation of Cisformer, on per-gene and within-cell Spearman correlation in all sixty paired fold comparisons, with 3.8 times shorter training. Transformer pipelines come within 0.02-0.04 on within-cell profile shape but lag by 0.10-0.24 on per-gene correlation. On two withheld cell types per-gene correlation is low; controls show the podocyte values are typical of within-type correlation for seen cell types of the same size, whereas Paneth values match a cell-agnostic shuffle for every Omic Translator arm. Within the transformer family, prespecified ablations show the Perceiver encoder was worth +0.0439 in within-donor per-gene correlation over full self-attention, a chromosome-aware genomic attention prior reduced it by 0.0096 (exact donor-level sign-flip test, Holm-adjusted p = 1.2e-4), and decoder output order had no detectable effect. A training-mean profile reaches 0.314 within-cell correlation with no input and a constant at the true expressed-gene positions reaches 0.996 per-gene correlation, so oracle-support protocols are reported only as diagnostics. Code, results and an audited release are provided.

items.title: Coupling cellular trajectories and RNA kinetics on continuous expression manifolds with ManifoldVelo
items.title_zh: 在连续表达流形上耦合细胞轨迹与RNA动力学：ManifoldVelo
items.summary_zh: 从静态单细胞转录组中联合恢复伪时间和RNA速率，需要协调全局轨迹结构与局部表达变化，尤其是在复杂周期和分支分化中。在此我们介绍ManifoldVelo，一个拓扑条件框架，联合学习细胞坐标、连续RNA轨迹和调控动力学。未剪接和剪接RNA轨迹的导数与转录-剪接-降解动力学相匹配，包括在观测细胞之间，使表达重建、细胞排序和动力学估计相互 informing。ManifoldVelo在所有评估的单细胞轨迹类型中恢复伪时间，包括循环、多分支和光滑非分支轨迹。ManifoldVelo在多峰循环模拟中在所比较方法中实现最佳伪时间恢复，并在多峰循环和分支模拟中实现剪接RNA速率最高方向一致性。真实数据分析支持跨实验板的相位预测，以及与胰腺发育阶段和标记表达一致的分化轨迹。其核心优势在于在可复用的动态参考中联合恢复不同轨迹结构中的时间位置和局部动力学。新细胞仅从剪接RNA即可获得伪时间和速率预测，无需重新拟

extra.description: Jointly recovering pseudotime and RNA velocity from static single-cell transcriptomes requires reconciling global trajectory structure with local expression changes, particularly in complex cycles and branching differentiation. Here we introduce ManifoldVelo, a topology-conditioned framework that jointly learns cellular coordinates, continuous RNA trajectories and regulatory kinetics. Derivatives of unspliced and spliced RNA trajectories are matched to transcription-splicing-degradation dynamics, including between observed cells, allowing expression reconstruction, cellular ordering and kinetic estimation to inform one another. ManifoldVelo recovers pseudotime across all evaluated single-cell trajectory types, including cyclic, multibranch and smooth non-branching trajectories. ManifoldVelo achieves the best pseudotime recovery among compared methods in multipeak cyclic simulations and the highest directional agreement for spliced RNA velocity in both multipeak cyclic and branching simulations. Real-data analyses support phase prediction across experimental plates and differentiation trajectories consistent with pancreatic developmental stages and marker expression. Its central advantage is the joint recovery of temporal position and local dynamics across distinct trajectory structures within a reusable dynamic reference. New cells are assigned pseudotime and velocity predictions from spliced RNA alone, without refitting the reference model. ManifoldVelo provides a foundation for dynamic cell atlases that transfer learned temporal and kinetic information to new samples.

items.title: BARRR: Bidimensional Augmented Reduced Rank Regression for Multi-View Multi-Cohort Data
items.title_zh: BARRR：用于多视图多队列数据的双向增强降秩回归
items.summary_zh: 跨多个队列（即样本组）和视图（即来源或模态）的双向数据整合在生物医学研究中至关重要，以从异质数据集中获得整体见解。然而，大多数现有整合方法侧重于单一维度，如跨不同来源的多视图整合或跨不同样本组的多队列整合。现有的双向整合方法稀缺且主要无监督，忽视了协变量提供的宝贵见解。为解决这一空白，我们引入双向增强降秩回归（baRRR）方法。我们的方法同时建模协变量相关和不相关效应，同时在两个维度上分解效应水平（全局、部分共享和个体）。大量模拟证明了我们的方法在信号恢复、结果预测和缺失数据插补方面的优势。我们将方法应用于癌症基因组图谱（TCGA）数据，使用体细胞突变作为协变量来告知不同组学平台和癌症类型间的变异模式。这些研究突出了其作为生物医学研究中稳健且适应性强的整合分析工具的潜力。

extra.description: Bidimensional data integration across multiple cohorts (i.e., sample groups) and views (i.e., sources or modalities) is crucial in biomedical research to derive holistic insights from heterogeneous datasets. However, most existing integrative methods focus on a single dimension, such as multi-view integration across distinct sources or multi-cohort integration across distinct sample groups. Existing approaches for bidimensional integration are scarce and predominantly unsupervised, overlooking the valuable insights offered by covariates. To address this gap, we introduce the Bidimensional Augmented Reduced Rank Regression (baRRR) method. Our approach models covariate-related and unrelated effects concurrently, while also decomposing effect levels (global, partially shared, and individual) across both dimensions. Extensive simulations demonstrate the advantages of our method with respect to signal recovery, outcome prediction, and missing data imputation. We apply our approach to data from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), using somatic mutations as covariates to inform patterns of variability across different omics platforms and cancer types. These studies highlight its potential as a robust and adaptable tool for integrative analysis in biomedical research.

items.title: Reducing double-dipping in single-cell topic models with three-way count splitting
items.title_zh: 用三向计数拆分减少单细胞主题模型中的双重 dipping
items.summary_zh: 主题模型从单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据中学习基因程序，然后相同的计数被用于测试哪些基因和供体与这些程序相关。计数拆分是这种复用的标准补救措施，但当编码器读取每个细胞的计数时尚未被测试。在一个104,400细胞的狼疮队列中，每次运行300个置换零基因，朴素检验在名义5%水平下拒绝了36%的零基因-主题对，而通常的两向拆分拒绝了38%，因为编码器看到了被检验基因自身的留出计数。在单独的第三个计数上编码主题使用，使用beta-二项稀疏化，将此降低到7.7%（模型外基因为6.7%）；对于另外两个模型LDVAE和scETM，该率为7.0-7.3%（朴素为51-59%）。一个无标签干扰素程序在狼疮队列和预先指定的COVID-19队列的留出计数中发生偏移，供体水平主题使用预测疾病（AUROC 0.96），超越细胞类型比例（两个队列中分别为0.86和0.58）。校准和预测不依赖于模型。我们不

extra.description: Topic models learn gene programs from single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data, and the same counts are then used to test which genes and donors are associated with those programs. Count splitting is the standard remedy for this reuse, but it has not been tested when an encoder reads each cell's counts. On a 104,400-cell lupus cohort with 300 permuted null genes per run, naive tests rejected 36% of null gene-topic pairs at a nominal 5% level, and the usual two-way split rejected 38%, because the encoder sees the tested gene's own held-out count. Encoding topic usage on a separate third of the counts, with beta-binomial thinning, lowered this to 7.7% (6.7% for genes outside the model); for two other models, LDVAE and scETM, the rate was 7.0-7.3% (naive 51-59%). A label-free interferon program shifts in held-out counts in the lupus cohort and in a pre-specified COVID-19 cohort, and donor-level topic usage predicts disease (AUROC 0.96) beyond cell-type proportions (0.86 and 0.58 in the two cohorts). Calibration and prediction did not depend on the model. We do not claim better clustering, prediction or topic stability. Code, figures and result tables are public (MIT license; DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23307193).

items.title: Protocol for Discovering Convergent Molecular Networks across Multi-Omics Datasets Using Network Propagation
items.title_zh: 使用网络传播跨多组学数据集发现趋同分子网络的方案
items.summary_zh: 表型结果源于分子层之间的协调变化。尽管多组学数据捕捉互补的分子信号，但由于基因水平重叠有限，将其整合为连贯的生物机制仍然具有挑战性。网络传播将每个数据集中的重要基因命中映射到先验知识分子相互作用网络上，并将其信号扩散到邻近基因。对传播网络进行数学整合，随后进行聚类和通路富集，可揭示共享分子网络，从而指出跨正交分子层捕捉到的核心生物学。

extra.description: Phenotypic outcomes arise from coordinated changes across molecular layers. Although multi-omics data capture complementary molecular signals, integrating them into coherent biological mechanisms remains challenging due to limited overlap at the gene level. Network propagation maps significant gene hits from each dataset onto a prior knowledge molecular interaction network and diffuses their signals to neighboring genes. Mathematical integration of propagated networks, followed by clustering and pathway enrichment, reveals shared molecular networks, pinpointing the core biology captured across orthogonal molecular layers.

items.title: User Embeddings are Superpositions of Interpretable Behavioral Modes
items.title_zh: 用户嵌入是可解释行为模式的叠加
items.summary_zh: 用户嵌入是现代推荐、个性化和行为建模系统的核心组件。虽然这些嵌入可以紧凑地编码丰富的行为信息，但它们本质上是密集和不透明的，限制了可解释性。为解决这一差距，我们认为用户嵌入可以理解为可解释行为模式的稀疏叠加。这种结构直接由线性嵌入的用户行为生成模型预测，并通过叠加假设近似扩展到深度学习表示。叠加模式可以通过稀疏字典学习方法（如稀疏自编码器（SAE））自然恢复，恢复的模式可以用自然语言自动命名和查询。我们在合成数据上针对已知真实值验证模式恢复，其中SAE比经典稀疏基线更好地恢复模式，包括在transformer编码的嵌入上。然后我们将该方法应用于来自两个真实世界数据集的经典和基于transformer的用户嵌入。我们还展示了相应的自然语言标签如何实现零样本受众检索和表征从未在文本上训练的嵌入。该框架是事后且模型无关的，不需要修改上游嵌入系统。

extra.description: User embeddings are central components of modern recommendation, personalization, and behavioral modeling systems. Though these embeddings can compactly encode rich behavioral information, they are inherently dense and opaque, limiting interpretability. To address this gap, we argue that user embeddings can be understood as sparse superpositions of interpretable behavioral modes. This structure is directly predicted by generative models of user behavior for linear embeddings and extends approximately to deep-learning representations by the superposition hypothesis. Superimposed modes can naturally be recovered by sparse dictionary learning methods, such as sparse autoencoders (SAEs), and recovered modes can be automatically named and queried in natural language. We validate mode recovery against known ground truth on synthetic data, where SAEs recover modes better than classical sparse baselines, including on transformer-encoded embeddings. We then apply the method to classical and transformer-based user embeddings from two real-world datasets. We also show how the corresponding natural-language labels enable zero-shot audience retrieval and characterization over embeddings never trained on text. The framework is post-hoc and model-agnostic, requiring no modification to the upstream embedding system.

items.title: XStack: A Benchmark for ML Repo Migration
items.title_zh: XStack：ML仓库迁移基准
items.summary_zh: ML代码应该在研究人员选择的地方运行，而不是最初编写的地方。如今，机器学习代码主要存在于两个生态系统中：NVIDIA GPU上的PyTorch和Google TPU上的JAX。在这些之间迁移仓库意味着跨框架和硬件进行构建和测试。这种迁移是（1）实际需求，因为它为研究人员解锁不同的硬件，以及（2）自然基准：它涉及不同的框架和硬件，覆盖整个仓库，并且是长视野和具有挑战性的。我们引入了XStack，一个评估代理在这两个生态系统之间迁移ML仓库的基准。每个代理收到一个PyTorch仓库和一台干净的TPU机器，必须交付一个JAX仓库。如果其输出符合我们的评分标准，则通过，评分标准基于源仓库的已发布结果，由我们认证和校准。代理迁移仍然不可靠：Claude Opus 5通过75%，GPT-5.6-sol通过45%，其他每个代理最多40%。XStack是朝着将ML代码从其生态系统中解放出来迈出的一步。我们

extra.description: ML code should run where researchers choose, not where it was first written. Today, machine learning code mainly lives in two ecosystems, PyTorch on NVIDIA GPUs and JAX on Google TPUs. Migrating repositories between them means building and testing across frameworks and hardware. This migration is (1) a practical need, since it unlocks different hardware for researchers, and (2) a natural benchmark: it involves different frameworks and hardware, covers whole repositories, and is long-horizon and challenging. We introduce XStack, a benchmark that evaluates agents on migrating ML repositories between these two ecosystems. Each agent receives a PyTorch repository and a clean TPU machine and must deliver a JAX repository. Its output passes if it meets our grading criteria, based on the source repository's published result, authenticated and calibrated by us. Migration by agents remains unreliable: Claude Opus 5 passes 75%, GPT-5.6-sol 45%, and every other agent at most 40%. XStack is a step toward freeing ML code from its ecosystem. We release XStack to make progress toward reliable migration across frameworks and hardware measurable.

items.title: Towards interpreting any residual stream direction by scaling activation inversion
items.title_zh: 通过缩放激活反演来解释任何残差流方向
items.summary_zh: 要解释语言模型残差流中的一个方向，我们可以寻找强烈激活它的文本。但当通过扫描语料库找到这样的文本时，它受限于该语料库包含的内容。我们开发了最大激活示例元模型（MAEM），这是一种语言模型，将主体模型的残差流方向映射到强烈激活这些方向的文本示例。我们的目标是最大化提供的残差流方向与MAEM生成的文本激活之间的余弦相似度。这种无标签RL目标有助于在不同来源的残差流方向上扩展MAEM。在经验上，我们发现所得的元模型产生信息丰富的示例：一个Qwen3.6-27B MAEM在反演留出激活方面优于语料库搜索或自然语言自编码器（NLA），在大多数留出语言/领域上击败语料库搜索（1000万token），并激活89%的留出SAE特征。它还能识别引导向量背后的概念，与NLA大致相当，比语料库搜索更频繁地恢复LoRA后门的有效载荷，甚至可以口述一些模型工作空间的内心独白。与其他元模型（如NLA）产生的解释不同，

extra.description: To interpret a direction in a language model's residual stream, we can look for text that strongly activates it. But when such text is found by scanning a corpus, it is limited to what that corpus contains. We develop Maximally-Activating Example Metamodels (MAEMs), language models which map residual stream directions from a subject model to text exemplars that strongly activate those directions. Our objective is to maximise the cosine similarity of a supplied residual stream direction with the activations of the text generated by the MAEM. This label-free RL objective helps to scale MAEMs on diverse sources of residual stream directions. Empirically, we find the resultant metamodel produces informative exemplars: a Qwen3.6-27B MAEM inverts held-out activations better than corpus search or a natural-language autoencoder (NLA), beats corpus search (at 10M tokens) on a majority of held-out languages/domains, and activates 89% of held-out SAE features. It also identifies concepts behind steering vectors about as well as NLAs, recovers the payloads of LoRA backdoors more often than corpus search, and can even verbalise some model workspace inner monologue. Unlike explanations produced by other metamodels (e.g. NLAs), MAEM exemplars can be verified with a forward pass on the subject model, making the MAEM objective a grounded alternative for scaling the training of metamodels.

items.title: Naked antisense oligonucleotides access the cytosol during early endocytic trafficking
items.title_zh: 裸反义寡核苷酸在早期内吞运输过程中进入细胞质
items.summary_zh: 硫代磷酸修饰的反义寡核苷酸（ASO）进入细胞，但其有效逃逸位点仍不确定。我们结合活细胞成像和比率pH测量来追踪一种无需递送载体即可内化的靶向Malat1的ASO。在U2OS细胞中，在将Malat1 RNA降低>90%的条件下，不到4%的内化ASO到达细胞核。大多数ASO积累在晚期内体、内溶酶体和溶酶体中，表现为焦点和广泛分布的腔内信号。这些区室经历中和，没有可检测的膜破裂或galectin-3募集。ASO焦点显示受限运动，与内溶酶体成分的关联一致。L-亮氨酰-L-亮氨酸甲酯诱导的膜损伤或钙依赖性溶酶体胞吐释放葡聚糖，同时保留腔内ASO。应激颗粒支架蛋白G3BP1/2的缺失适度增强ASO活性，没有可检测的内溶酶体损伤。Tantalosin，一种扰动内体回收的小分子，将ESCRT-III蛋白IST1重新分布到内体。它增强了SYTOX Green和ASO的早期逃逸，通过核积累检测到，并增加了Ma

extra.description: Phosphorothioate-modified antisense oligonucleotides (ASOs) enter cells, but their site of productive escape remains uncertain. We combined live-cell imaging and ratiometric pH measurements to follow a Malat1-targeting ASO internalized without a delivery vehicle. In U2OS cells, less than 4% of internalized ASO reached the nucleus under conditions that reduced Malat1 RNA by >90%. Most ASO accumulated in late endosomes, endolysosomes and lysosomes as foci and broadly distributed luminal signal. These compartments underwent neutralization without detectable membrane rupture or galectin-3 recruitment. ASO foci showed constrained motion, consistent with association with endolysosomal constituents. L-leucyl-L-leucine methyl ester-induced membrane damage or Calcium dependent lysosome exocytosis released dextran while retaining luminal ASO. Loss of the stress-granule scaffolding proteins G3BP1/2 modestly enhanced ASO activity without detectable endolysosomal damage. Tantalosin, a small molecule that perturbs endosomal recycling, redistributed the ESCRT-III protein IST1 to endosomes. It enhanced early escape of SYTOX Green and ASOs, detected by nuclear accumulation, and increased Malat1 knockdown, with cell-type-dependent responses. Tantalosin did not detectably increase nuclear ASO accumulation after sequestration in late compartments. These findings place productive ASO escape early in endocytic trafficking, most likely in early or recycling endosomes, before sequestration in largely nonproductive late compartments.

items.title: SMARTFlexDB: a paired apo-holo RNA structure database and analysis platform for RNA conformational flexibility and small-molecule recognition
items.title_zh: SMARTFlexDB：一个用于RNA构象灵活性和小分子识别的配对apo-holo RNA结构数据库和分析平台
items.summary_zh: RNA结构在小分子结合后可以发生实质性构象变化，然而现有结构资源仅提供静态RNA-配体快照，没有将配体结合（holo）RNA结构与相应的无配体（apo）构象连接起来。SMARTFlexDB是一个 curated 数据库和分析平台，使用配对的apo-holo RNA结构来表征构象差异和RNA-小分子识别。候选对通过匹配具有至少90%序列同一性和覆盖率以及完全保守结合口袋核苷酸的RNA链从蛋白质数据库中鉴定。当前版本包含来自266个holo结构的434个结合口袋，链接到186个apo结构，产生1187个口袋级apo-holo对，组织为734个数据库条目，涵盖150个小分子和23个RNA功能类别。每个条目整合RNA序列和二级结构注释、apo和holo三维结构、RNA-配体原子相互作用以及全局和局部构象变化的定量描述符。交互式网络界面使用户能够探索序列比对和结构叠加，比较二级结构和RNA基序，并上

extra.description: RNA structures can undergo substantial conformational changes upon small-molecule binding, yet existing structural resources provide only static RNA-ligand snapshots without connecting ligand-bound (holo) RNA structures to corresponding ligand-free (apo) conformations. SMARTFlexDB is a curated database and analysis platform that uses paired apo-holo RNA structures to characterize conformational differences and RNA-small molecule recognition. Candidate pairs were identified from the Protein Data Bank by matching RNA chains with at least 90% sequence identity and coverage, and fully conserved binding pocket nucleotides. The current release contains 434 binding pockets from 266 holo structures, linked to 186 apo structures to yield 1187 pocket-level apo-holo pairs organized into 734 database entries, spanning 150 small molecules and 23 RNA functional classes. Each entry integrates RNA sequence and secondary-structure annotations, apo and holo three-dimensional structures, RNA-ligand atomic interactions, and quantitative descriptors of global and local conformational changes. An interactive web interface enables users to explore sequence alignments and structural overlays, compare secondary structures and RNA motifs, and upload paired apo-holo structures for customized analysis. By linking ligand-bound and ligand-free RNA structures, SMARTFlexDB provides a robust foundation for investigating RNA structural flexibility and supporting RNA-targeted small-molecule drug discovery. The database and analysis platform are available at https://aidd.rc.ufl.edu/app/smartflexdb/.

items.title: Bayesian model-based method for clustering gene expression time series with multiple replicates
items.title_zh: 基于贝叶斯模型的聚类基因表达时间序列与多个重复的方法
items.summary_zh: 背景：在本研究中，我们介绍了一种基于贝叶斯模型的聚类具有多个重复的转录组学时间序列数据的方法。该技术基于在狄利克雷过程（DP）的无限混合模型内采样高斯过程（GP）。我们的方法使用多个GP模型来适应每个聚类内多个行为不同的实验重复。我们称之为多模型狄利克雷过程高斯过程（MMDPGP）混合模型。我们将我们的方法与处理具有多个重复的基因表达时间序列的最先进基于模型的聚类方法进行比较。结果：为证明我们方法的准确性，我们用它来聚类合成生成的数据集。我们的方法在合成数据上产生的聚类与最先进方法相比具有显著更高的纯度分数。我们还提出了一个案例研究，其中所有方法都应用于聚类具有三个不同实验重复的肉毒梭菌的RNA-Seq时间序列。基因富集分析获得的结果表明，MMDPGP产生的聚类中显著富集的基因集数量更多。结论：通过用单独的GP建模每个重复，我们的方法可以利用实验重复之间的自然变异性来了解更多潜在生物学。

extra.description: Background: In this study, we introduce a Bayesian model-based method for clustering transcriptomics time series data with multiple replicates. This technique is based on sampling Gaussian processes (GPs) within an infinite mixture model from a Dirichlet process (DP). Our method uses multiple GP models to accommodate for multiple differently behaving experimental replicates within each cluster. We call it multiple models Dirichlet process Gaussian process (MMDPGP) mixture model. We compare our method with state-of-the-art model-based clustering approaches for handling gene expression time series with multiple replicates. Results: To demonstrate the accuracy of our method we use it to cluster synthetically generated data sets. The clusters produced by our method on the synthetic data had a significantly higher purity score compared to the state-of-the- art approaches. We also present a case study where all methods are applied for clustering RNA-Seq time series of Clostridium botulinum with three different experimental replicates. The results obtained from the gene enrichment analysis showed that the number of significantly enriched sets of genes is larger in the clusters produced by MMDPGP. Conclusions: By modelling each replicate with a separate GP, our method can use the natural variability between experimental replicates to learn more about the underlying biology.

items.summary_zh: 近日，爱奇艺会员被指出现“年度最恶心的广告”。 据极目新闻报道，当事人小敏（化名）介绍，11月3日晚，作为爱奇艺白金会员的她通过平板上的爱奇艺App观看电视剧时，将电视剧投屏至安装了奇异果App的电视观看。结果临近剧情大结局的关键情节，屏幕上下左右突然飞入大量带着“CS扫描王”标识的弹幕。 网传视频显示，爱奇艺此次的弹幕广告虽与剧情有一定相关性，但文案都比较生硬，十分刻意。 小敏表示，几分钟后，在同一集里这一情况又出现了一次，其他剧集里则没有出现，两段广告加起来有大约20秒长。而自己此前也从未见过类似投放方式，观感被严重影响。 对此，小敏在网上分享的帖子上写道，“CS扫描王的广告，选择了一种最为恶毒的方式污染了我尊贵的眼睛”。 不过，广告投放商CS扫描王则向媒体表示“委屈”，否认干扰与公司有关。其客服人员直称，公司正常在爱奇艺平台上投放广告，至于如何操作这个广告，则并不清楚，因此建议咨询平

items.title_zh: 张雪称若学生同意，将公开面试过程，会参加 36 名重庆大学学生二面，有利于缓解之前的争议吗？
items.summary_zh: 11月6日，张雪更新视频称，经确认本次校招共有36名重庆大学学生进入二面。他表示，自己将参与这36人的面试，并承诺如果对方同意，会将面试过程公开。谈及此次舆论风波，他认为“这就是有些主播为了流量而狂奔制造出来的热搜事件”。在他看来，实际上根本就不存在学生高傲，企业傲慢的问题。https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/5-MpemEunKDRCCAfK6Lp4A

items.title: 陕西商南重大刑案嫌疑人因情感纠纷持刀行凶，经两天搜捕在深山被找到，系自杀身亡，哪些关键点值得注意？
items.title_zh: 陕西商南重大刑案嫌疑人因情感纠纷持刀行凶，经两天搜捕在深山被找到，系自杀身亡，哪些关键点值得注意？

items.title: 民主党提出超级 AI 禁令，美股迎来 1896 年以来中期选举后表现最差的第二个交易日，影响有多大？
items.title_zh: 民主党提出超级 AI 禁令，美股迎来 1896 年以来中期选举后表现最差的第二个交易日，影响有多大？
items.summary_zh: 快科技 11 月 5 日消息，美国民主党宣布推动《禁止人工超级智能法案》，全面封杀超级 AI 研发，明文禁止任何个人或企业机构研发及部署人工超级智能（ASI）。 根据法案草案，ASI 为具备以下特征的系统：一是在广泛领域与任务中达到或超越人类认知表现与能力的 AI 架构，或可轻易被修改以展现出该能力的系统；二是具备足以策划并执行削弱人类主导权、甚至推翻或破坏美国政府体系的 AI 系统。 法案要求全面暂停所有先进 AI 的研发进程，直至联邦层级的专属监管机构正式运作，并建立清晰的法规与模型审查机制。 为确保禁令落实，法案提议设立全新内阁级别的人工智能部，专责监管前沿 AI 模型的全生命周期，并有权强制技术团队消除系统内的高风险功能，包括忽视人类关机指令、未经授权进行网络攻击或自我递归升级等潜在失控行为。 违规罚则方面，涉案企业将面临被强制解散处分，违规个人最高可被判处 20 年联邦监禁，量刑

items.title: 儿子偷卖母亲 13 克金项链，母亲得知真相后报警，儿子被采取刑事强制措施，拿自己家的东西算偷吗？
items.title_zh: 儿子偷卖母亲 13 克金项链，母亲得知真相后报警，儿子被采取刑事强制措施，拿自己家的东西算偷吗？
items.summary_zh: “倒下了兄弟们。”朋友圈照片里，一条金项链摆在一台电子秤上，配文只有这六个字。发照片的人是赵女士的儿子。 项链13.29克，他以每克870元卖出，得款11562元，随后出门旅游。 赵女士是一位环卫工。她一度以为项链是在清扫街道时弄丢了，直到其外甥近日刷到她儿子的这条朋友圈，她核对后才知道是儿子拿走了自己的项链。此前，赵女士的儿子多次偷拿家中财物变卖挥霍。这一次，赵女士没有再心软，主动报了警。 儿子在母亲陪同下自首，目前已被公安机关采取刑事强制措施。 近日，浙江省绍兴市公安局越城区分局披露了这起案件。一个很多人以为“不算事”的问题被摆上台面：拿自己家的东西，到底算不算偷？赵女士报警之后，还能撤案吗？https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/ApGzUx8MNKNYcTq34JKKWQ

items.title: 美股创 19 个月来最大单日跌幅、纳指暴跌5.52%，科技股遭遇抛售潮，引发市场恐慌的核心原因是什么？
items.title_zh: 美股创 19 个月来最大单日跌幅、纳指暴跌5.52%，科技股遭遇抛售潮，引发市场恐慌的核心原因是什么？
items.summary_zh: 美东时间周四，美股遭遇猛烈抛售，科技股成为重灾区。纳斯达克综合指数单日暴跌5.52%，创下19个月以来最大单日跌幅，并较10月6日创下的历史收盘高点回落超过10%，正式进入技术性回调区间。 标普500指数和道琼斯工业平均指数也大幅下挫，三大股指均创下2025年4月特朗普宣布“解放日”关税政策以来最大单日跌幅。 民主党赢得中期选举后，美股周三大幅上涨，但随着投资者连续第二个交易日撤离科技股，纳斯达克综合指数周四暴跌。科技股占比较高的纳指下跌 3.3%，标普 500 指数下跌 1.9%。道琼斯工业平均指数下跌 489 点，跌幅 0.9%。尽管雪佛龙和强生等股票上涨，但仍不足以抵消科技股抛售对道指的拖累。人工智能相关股票，尤其是芯片行业和数据中心相关股票，连续第二天下跌。 根据 MSX.COM 数据，美光科技(MU.O)跌 9%、SK 海力士(SKHY.O)跌 8.8%、英伟达(NVDA.O)跌

items.title: 太原一小学招「跟岗教师」无薪资食宿、备用上岗，要求本科有教资，人社局回应肯定不对，为什么会有这种形式？
items.title_zh: 太原一小学招「跟岗教师」无薪资食宿、备用上岗，要求本科有教资，人社局回应肯定不对，为什么会有这种形式？
items.summary_zh: 近日，山西太原一小学无薪酬招聘“跟岗教师”，引发关注。 太原万柏林区育华小学招聘信息显示，面向社会招募跟岗教师，备用上岗，无薪酬待遇，食宿需自理。主要工作内容为参与备课、听课、磨课、试教、作业批改、班级管理、课后服务、校园活动组织等教育教学相关工作。招聘岗位包括语文、数学、英语、科学、音乐、体育、美术。 其中，关于待遇与保障，招聘中称“学校提供跟岗岗位及教育教学资源，无薪酬待遇；跟岗期间须遵守学校各项管理制度；学校可以安排校内午休，请自行解决食宿问题”。 招聘要求为全日制普通院校本科及以上学历；取得小学及以上学段教师资格证，应聘岗位须与教师资格证相符，大学所学专业与教学专业一致；且正式上岗前取得本科毕业证、学位证、教师资格证、普通话水平二级甲等及以上证书等。 值得注意的是，该校分别在今年6月、9月曾发布类似招聘内容，当时招聘的岗位为“跟岗实习教师”，依然是“备用上岗”。 对此，11月5日，

items.title_zh: 全国 3.35 万座寺院、 9000 座道观同步启动财务大检查，到底意味着什么？
items.summary_zh: 一场覆盖全国3.35万座寺院、9000座道观的财务大检查正全面铺开，核心是推动宗教场所去商业化、回归非营利属性，把“钱袋子”晒在阳光下。 一、检查覆盖范围与核心内容 覆盖对象：全国依法登记的3.35万座寺院、9000座道观全部纳入，福建、江西、四川、河北等多地已率先落地，部分地区还将其他固定宗教活动处所一并纳入。 五大核查维度：检查围绕制度合规性、账目规范性、资产完整性、公开时效性和关键环节专项核查展开。全国3.35万座寺院、9000座道观财务大检查铺开，推动去商业化

items.title: 如何看待万斯公开批评特朗普政策称共和党败选是因为伊朗战争？他是在与特朗普进行切割吗？
items.title_zh: 如何看待万斯公开批评特朗普政策称共和党败选是因为伊朗战争？他是在与特朗普进行切割吗？
items.summary_zh: 当地时间11月4日，美国副总统万斯通过社交媒体发文，分析共和党在中期选举中失利的原因。他表示，共和党选民的投票率并非主要问题，真正的问题在于，部分曾在2024年总统选举中支持特朗普和万斯的选民，在2026年中期选举中转而支持民主党。 万斯援引一名民调专家的调查称，转而支持民主党的选民主要提出了四项诉求：结束战争、将重点放在生活成本和通货膨胀问题上、奉行“美国优先”政策，以及调整美国与以色列的关系。万斯认为，共和党此次失利的根本原因是伊朗战争，并称美国总统特朗普前一晚也谈到了这一点。 多家美国媒体预测，美国民主党在3日举行的中期选举中力压共和党夺回参议院和众议院控制权，重新掌控美国国会。（总台记者 赵淼） 更多资讯请下载央视新闻客户端

items.title_zh: 美国时隔多年再现民主党包揽国会两院、共和党总统在任的局面，AI基建扩张是否迎来变数？未来美股会怎么走？
items.summary_zh: 新华社报道，美国中期选举于11月3日举行。据美国媒体预测，民主党在选举中力压共和党重获国会参议院和众议院控制权。 分析人士认为，特朗普政府发起的“关税战”和对伊朗军事行动抬升美国国内物价和生活成本，引发选民不满，成为共和党选举惨败主要原因。随着民主党掌控国会两院，特朗普政府后续施政将面临更大阻力。 汹涌的“蓝潮” 美东时间3日18时起，全美范围内投票陆续结束。数小时后，舆论此前预判的“蓝潮”（蓝色和红色分别是民主党和共和党的代表色）逐渐显现，民主党候选人在各地接连赢得选举。至午夜，多家主流媒体预测，民主党锁定参众两院控制权。 在众议院，此次选举改选全部435个议席，民主党增加3席就可获得“控场”所需的218席。最新预测结果显示，民主党预计最终将拿到超过245个席位。在竞争激烈的宾夕法尼亚、艾奥瓦、肯塔基等关键州的多个选区，民主党人都击败共和党对手。而这些选区在2024年总统选举中都是特朗普

items.title: 美国多州州长拟暂停审批 AI 数据中心，将对算力基建产生哪些连锁反应？
items.title_zh: 美国多州州长拟暂停审批 AI 数据中心，将对算力基建产生哪些连锁反应？
items.summary_zh: 凤凰网财经 美国AI基建的狂飙突进，正迎来一场始料未及的“政治变天”。在周二举行的美国选举中，民主党大获全胜——不仅从共和党手中夺下国会参众两院控制权，更在得克萨斯、佐治亚、俄亥俄等多个数据中心重镇赢下州长宝座。这四位新当选的州长，无一例外都把“严管数据中心”写进了竞选纲领。据测算，全美约半数拟建AI数据中心项目，或将因此陷入更严格的地方审查与阻力之中。市场的神经已被率先挑动，彭博数据显示，周三（10月4日）早盘，标普500指数期货一度下挫1.2%，纳斯达克100指数期货更是重挫2.2%，三星电子、SK海力士、台积电等全球AI硬件供应链应声下跌。 得州“最坏剧本”成真：13吉瓦产能命悬一线 对数据中心开发商而言，得克萨斯的选情堪称“最坏结局”。Gina Hinojosa当选州长，成为“孤星之州”30多年来首位民主党州长。竞选期间，她反复呼吁立即暂停数据中心开发，并将共和党现任州长Greg

items.title: 有消息称 Anthropic IPO 已被取消，媒体称消息并不可靠，到底怎么回事？被取消可能性有多大？
items.title_zh: 有消息称 Anthropic IPO 已被取消，媒体称消息并不可靠，到底怎么回事？被取消可能性有多大？
items.summary_zh: 美国今天中期选举结果出炉，总统所在的阵营大败，突变的政局也会影响AI产业，对AI监管及数据中心建设会有更严格的要求。 这样的环境下，又突然传出了Anthropic的IPO上市被取消的消息，这可是全球AI行业的关键转折，因为Anthropic公司要以至少2万亿美元的市值上市。 不过爆料消息的账号并不可靠，这个新闻也没有权威报道，取消IPO是不可能的。2万亿美元的Anthropic IPO被指取消？假的 有社交媒体传言称 Anthropic 的 IPO 被取消了。

items.title_zh: 红果短剧人均日刷 151 分钟且观看时长超爱优腾 3.8 倍，为什么短剧能如此吸睛？
items.summary_zh: 【#红果短剧人均日刷151分钟##红果观看时长是爱优腾3.8倍#】近日，据《财经》援引QuestMobile数据，2025年一季度至2026年7月至8月，红果月活跃用户从1.68亿增长至4.03亿，日活跃用户从5200万增长至1.77亿。据界面新闻，更值得注意的是观看时间。2026年7月至8月，红果月均总使用时长约8321亿分钟，是爱奇艺、腾讯视频、优酷三家长视频平台合计的3.8倍。同期，红果月活跃用户的人均单日使用时长约151分钟，相较年初的125分钟又有增长。 抖音、微信和小红书分别约为133.5分钟、98.3分钟和95.7分钟。#红果短剧到底有多离谱# 【#红果短剧人均日刷151分钟##红果观看时长是爱优腾3.8倍#】近日，据《财经》援引questmobile数据，2025年一季度至2026年7月至8月，红果月活跃用户从1.68亿增长至4.03亿，日活跃用户从5200万增长至1.77

items.title: 女子分段买票升一等座因车厢重联不通只能站着，12306 称不退差价无补偿合理吗？
items.title_zh: 女子分段买票升一等座因车厢重联不通只能站着，12306 称不退差价无补偿合理吗？
items.summary_zh: #12306回应买一等座却只能站着# 【女子高铁分段买票中途升一等座，最终却只能站着，当事人：两组车厢不连通，中途也不停站；12306：平台不退差价，也无补偿】#12306称重联列车不互通不补偿# 近日，一名网友特意分段买票，想从二等座升到一等座，却因为两组车厢不连通，最后花了一等座的钱，全程只能站着。当事人称，11月1日她乘坐D655次列车，先买了湖州到杭州东3车厢的二等座，接着买了同趟车9车厢杭州东到宁波的一等座。 她准备从3车厢走去9车厢时，却在8、9车厢连接处被挡住了。她这才知道，自己坐的是8+8重联列车：1到8节是一组，9到16节是另一组，两列车拼接在一起，中间不互通。想换组，只能等列车到站停靠时，从站台上绕过去。由于这趟列车中途不停车，她无法下车绕行。原来的二等座也让出去了，无奈之下，她只能花一等座的钱，在车厢站了一小时抵达宁波。当事人希望借自己的经历提醒大家买票时多留意。11
